item.title: Witch Hat Dippers
item.description: Crescent roll dough triangles is topped with cheese, mushrooms, and pepperoni in these cute witch hat dippers that are great for Halloween parties.

item.title: Vegetable Cutlets
item.description: These easy vegetarian patties are great for a snack or as an appetizer. Serve with ketchup or Indian style mint chutney on the side. You can also add cauliflower or corn if you choose.

item.title: Tomato Bruschetta
item.description: Fresh tomatoes are combined with garlic, basil, and balsamic vinegar in this classic appetizer. Melted mozzarella cheese makes it extra special.

item.title: Sweet Potato "Hummus"
item.description: Sweet potatoes prove a worthy alternative to chickpeas in Chef John's new spin on hummus starring the usual tahini, garlic, lemon, and olive oil.

item.title: Sweet and Sticky Wings
item.description: Sweet and sticky wings with plenty of garlic make a tasty and quick-to-prepare appetizer. Serve with a pile of napkins!

item.title: Spicy Guacamole with Chipotle
item.description: Amped up with jalapeno and chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, this spicy guacamole is great as a dip or on sandwiches, burgers, or soups.

item.title: Skillet-Popped Lentils with Parsley
item.description: Lentils are skillet-toasted with a cayenne-parsley seasoning to make nutty popped lentils, a quick and easy, gluten-free snack or appetizer!

item.title: Sambusa
item.description: These Somalian sambusas feature spring roll wrappers filled with seasoned ground beef, onion, and leek for a popular fried, crispy Ramadan treat.

item.title: Russian Deviled Eggs
item.description: Grated beet provides the Russian influence on a classic deviled egg, and it turns them a lovely color.

item.title: Quick Mango Salsa
item.description: This fruity salsa is great with pita chips. You could use it to top salmon or your favorite grilled fish, steak, or pork chop. You can add pineapple for even more of a tropical flair. The possibilities for this recipe are endless!

item.title: Pizza Poppers
item.description: These pizza poppers are mini pizza bites, customized with your favorite pizza toppings. They're the perfect game day snack, finger-friendly for kids, and good for any get-together.

item.title: Maryland Pumpkin Seeds
item.description: Oven-toasted pumpkin seeds made with Old Bay seasoning make a tasty snack! Easy to prepare and perfect anytime you crave a salty, satisfying bite.

item.title: Empanadas de Jamon, Queso, y Huevo Duro (Ham, Cheese, and Hard-boiled Egg Empanadas)
item.description: Gouda, hard-boiled eggs, and smoked ham empanadas are light and full of flavor, just an easy midweek Mediterranean dinner or finger food.

item.title: Cucumber Chicken Roll-ups
item.description: These easy-to-make cucumber roll-ups filled with a chicken mixture topped with crunchy Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps are a tasty summer appetizer.

item.title: Cream Cheese Garlic Spread
item.description: Garlic and chives flavor this easy 3-ingredient cream cheese spread to serve with crisp crackers, Italian bread, or bagels.

item.title: Corned Beef Egg Roll
item.description: These deep-fried corned beef egg rolls are a crunchy, fun twist on the classic Reuben sandwich. A great way to use leftover corned beef from St. Patrick's Day.

item.title: Chipotle Bacon Deviled Eggs
item.description: These chipotle bacon deviled eggs are a smoky, spicy upgrade to the classic, with crispy bacon and chipotle peppers. Creamy, flavorful bites combine the richness of egg yolks with tangy mayo and the bold heat of chipotle in adobo.

item.title: Bacon Wrapped Asparagus
item.description: Bacon wrapped asparagus is easy to make with 3 ingredients for a delicious appetizer or side of crispy bacon and tender asparagus in every bite!

item.title: Awesome Blossom Onion Bites
item.description: These awesome blossom onion bites are a great way to capture the magic of a fried blooming onion, and they are much easier to make than deep frying a whole onion at home. A recipe for the perfect dipping sauce is included.

item.title: A and Z Dip
item.description: A cold artichoke and zucchini dip that can be served with crackers, corn chips, or raw vegetables. Add more hot sauce or pico de gallo seasoning to spice it up!

item.title: Homemade Vegan Cheese with Cranberries
item.description: This vegan cheese recipe with cashew nuts and miso paste is rolled in chopped walnuts, hazelnuts, and cranberries for a festive vegan appetizer.

item.title: Devilishly Different Green Deviled Eggs
item.description: These deviled eggs are devilishly different: first of all, they are green - made with avocado - and topped with hot, pickled garlic cloves.

item.title: Air Fryer Chicken Bites with Parmesan Cheese
item.description: Chicken pieces are cooked until crisp in the air fryer and topped with melted Parmesan cheese. Serve with marinara sauce for dipping.

item.title: Asparagus Wrapped in Crisp Prosciutto
item.description: Prosciutto-wrapped asparagus is a quick, elegant appetizer that's simple to prep with just 2 ingredients and easy to roast to crispy perfection.

item.title: Shrimp and Jalapeno Nachos
item.description: Light, crisp nachos topped with a shrimp, a sliver of jalapeno pepper, and some pepperjack cheese get a minute or 2 under the broiler for the perfect, tasty little bite.

item.title: Simply Good Eggs
item.description: A simple deviled egg recipe is always good to have on hand when you host a party.

item.title: Mini Sweet Potato Samosas
item.description: These attractive little samosas of curried sweet potatoes make a nice appetizer or cocktail party hors d'oeuvre!

item.title: Edamame Dip (Edamole)
item.description: This dip tastes like guacamole but made with edamame which has more protein and fiber. Serve it just like guacamole with raw veggies, tortilla chips, or pita bread.

item.title: Zucchini-Feta Rolls
item.description: If you are looking for a special antipasto try these zucchini-feta rolls. They need to marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 days, so they are a perfect appetizer to make ahead..

item.title: Three Chile Dry Roasted Tomatillo Salsa
item.description: Tomatillos and chiles are dry roasted in an iron skillet to make this wonderful, vegan Three Chile Tomatillo Salsa. Great for green chilaquiles.

item.title: Spicy and Tangy Hot Wings
item.description: This is my wing recipe that I've tweaked over the last 10 years to suit my specific tastes. If you don't like vinegar and cayenne; these wings will not be for you. I've never seen a middle ground with this recipe; they are either raved about or politely passed up. If you like a hotter wing experience, double the amounts of chili powder and cayenne powder. Enjoy with chunky blue cheese or ranch dressing.

item.title: Fresh and Light Cucumber Salsa
item.description: This is a fast and fresh salsa made with roma tomatoes, canned tomatoes and green chiles, cucumbers and cilantro.

item.title: Honey Mustard Ham and Cheese Sliders
item.description: These honey mustard ham and cheese sliders are miniature classic ham and Swiss sandwiches on Hawaiian rolls, with a homemade honey mustard sauce.

item.title: Screwdriver Jello Shots
item.description: These screwdriver jello shots are so fun. Orange peels are filled with fresh orange juice, vodka, and gelatin, then cut into jello shot wedges.

item.title: Shortcut Pierogies
item.description: These quick and easy pierogies are topped with caramelized onions, sour cream, and bacon, a stylish appetizer for a dinner party or fun gathering of friends. This is a shortcut method using frozen pierogies.

item.title: Deviled Potatoes
item.description: These deviled potatoes are so cute. Baby gold potatoes are scooped out, given a deviled egg treatment, and served as finger food-a delicious and fun spring appetizer.

item.title: Perfect Pita Chips
item.description: These crispy, garlicky pita chips are quick and easy to make with just a package of pita pockets, olive oil, garlic powder, and garlic salt.

item.title: Grilled Halloumi Kebabs
item.description: These vegetarian kebabs are delicious--halloumi cheese and tomatoes are threaded on skewers and marinated in a vinaigrette with basil and honey.

item.title: Watermelon Tomato Salsa
item.description: Watermelon and cantaloupe add sweetness to this salsa recipe.

item.title: Peanut Butter Burrito
item.description: Never miss class with this quick and easy burrito made with peanut butter and vanilla frosting that's "like crack" for the college crowd.

item.title: Roasted Carrot Dip
item.description: Surprise your guests with this unique and flavorful dip combining roasted carrots with a hint of heat from homemade chile oil.

item.title: Sweet and Spicy Barbecue Meatballs
item.description: The sweet and spicy sauce for these delicious party barbecue meatballs will have your guests coming back for more. And cleanup is easy when you bake the meatballs on Reynolds Wrap® Non-Stick Aluminum Foil.

item.title: Chipotle Peach Salsa with Cilantro
item.description: I came up with this fresh-tasting, spicy recipe one night as we fired up steaks smothered in a smoky hickory BBQ sauce on our new grill. The combination was a hit and this has definitely become a new favorite. We like our food spicy, so adjust the amount of chipotle and onion to suit your taste.

item.title: Roasted Elephant Garlic Cheese Spread
item.description: Roasted elephant garlic has a sweet nutty flavor that goes well with cream cheese in this delicious spread that's perfect for serving with veggies or on a bagel or crackers.

item.title: Tiropetes
item.description: Straight from Athens! Feta and Monterey Jack cheeses are mixed into a sauce with parsley and used to fill phyllo triangles in this delicious Greek appetizer.

item.title: Baked Salmon Wontons
item.description: Stuffed with cream cheese, onion, and jalapenos, these spicy salmon wontons make an easy, delicious appetizer that your guests will love.

item.title: Best Melon, Mango, and Avocado Salad
item.description: Tangy pickled onions and creamy avocados add a surprisingly savory bite to this crisp fruit salad. When served in a pretty martini glass, it makes a stunning first course.

item.title: Crab Rangoon Dip
item.description: Creamy crab dip with sweet, sour, and spicy seasonings is served on Pretzel Crisps® and topped with a bit more crab and sauce.
